data.title: 2H 2023 Transparency Report Statistics
data.content:
Kakao has not provided communication data since the first half of 2013. 
In response to requests for data on communication-restricting measures in Daum services, only data that strictly pertain to standards are provided after thorough review is conducted in accordance to relevant legislations. We do not provide any data on communication-restricting measures that pertain to Kakao services.
The number of requests for communication confirmation data and processed requests related to Daum services has decreased by 15.7% and 35.4%, respectively, compared to the first half of 2023. Meanwhile, the number of requests and processed requests related to Kakao services has increased over the same period by 37.4% and 36.7%, respectively. 
Requests for search and seizure warrants related to Daum services have slightly increased compared to the first half of 2023, while those for Kakao services have increased by 14.7% over the same period. 
The number of accounts processed in response to search and seizure warrants related to Daum services has decreased by almost a half compared to the first half of 2023, while those related to Kakao services has decreased by 10.3% over the same period. 
Kakao strives to provide only the minimum information necessary to meet the requirements.
